title: A General Topological Symmetry Index for Critical Orbits In Neural Network Loss Landscapes
abstract: arXiv:2610.28864v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A systematic understanding of the global structure of neural-network loss landscapes remains challenging due to their high dimensionality. Symmetries arising from network architectures and learning objectives provide a way to investigate aspects of this structure. Although a growing number of studies have drawn attention to these symmetries, a systematic characterization of them, as well as of the critical orbits they give rise to, remains incomplete. To address this gap, in this work we establish a topological symmetry index, based on the methodologies from the family of equivariant degree theories, to decode these symmetries. The frameworks apply to arbitrary network architectures and include methods applicable to degenerate critical orbits. translated_title: 神经网络损失景观中临界轨道的通用拓扑对称性指标
translated_abstract: 由于神经网络损失景观的高维性，对其全局结构的系统性理解仍然具有挑战性。源于网络架构和学习目标的对称性为研究这种结构的某些方面提供了一种途径。尽管越来越多的研究开始关注这些对称性，但对其以及它们所产生的临界轨道的系统性刻画仍然不完整。为填补这一空白，本工作基于等变度理论家族的方法论，建立了一个拓扑对称性指标来解码这些对称性。该框架适用于任意网络架构，并包含适用于退化临界轨道的方法。该指标能够检测临界点的迷向性，并量化相应的净拓扑贡献。文中给出了若干示例，包括softplus多层感知机、Transformer以及等变神经网络……
tldr: 本文基于等变度理论建立了一个通用的拓扑对称性指标，用于系统刻画神经网络损失景观中由架构对称性产生的临界轨道，能够检测临界点的迷向性并量化其净拓扑贡献，且适用于任意网络架构包括退化情形。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a general topological symmetry index based on equivariant degree theories to systematically characterize critical orbits arising from architectural symmetries in neural network loss landscapes, detecting the isotropy of critical points and quantifying their net topological contributions across arbitrary architectures including degenerate cases.
